    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    database
    Opens the PostgreSQL connection, manages records, and retrieves sales reports.
    database_app
    Launches the point-of-sale application using credentials entered at startup.
    database_controller
    Controls the cashier, manager, customization, order, and reporting views.
    database.DailySales
    Order count and sales total for a date.
    database.EmployeeOption
    Employee id and display name used for cashier selection.
    database.HourlySales
    Order count, sales total, and tips for a store hour.
    database.IceLevelOption
    Ice level option id and name.
    database.PeakSalesDay
    Date and sales total for a day with peak sales.
    database.ProductUsage
    Inventory item and estimated units consumed by drink sales.
    database.RestockItem
    Inventory stock and quantity needed to reach the minimum.
    database.SaleItem
    Drink customization and prices used to save a single-drink sale.
    database.SalesHistorySummary
    Sales history date range, totals, and menu item count.
    database.SalesSummary
    Order count and sales total for a reporting period.
    database.SweetnessOption
    Sweetness option id and percentage.
    database.ToppingOption
    Topping option id, name, and price.
    database.TopSellingDrink
    Drink name, order count, and sales total.
    database.WeeklySales
    Sales totals and date bounds for a dataset week.
    db_setup
    Stores the username and password used for database setup.
    employee
    Immutable record of an employee's id, name, and position.
    inventory_item
    Immutable record of an inventory items's id, name, and stock.
    menu_items
    Immutable record of a menu drink's id, name, category, and price.
